```{r}
sum(is.na(data$pm25_concentration))
```

```{r}
sum(is.na(data$pm10_concentration))

```
```{r}
pm25_stats <- summary(data$pm25_concentration)
pm10_stats <- summary(data$pm10_concentration)

pm25_stats

```
```{r}
pm10_stats

```
```{r}
pm25_mean <- mean(data$pm25_concentration, na.rm = TRUE)
pm10_mean <- mean(data$pm10_concentration, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
clean_data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    pm25_concentration = ifelse(is.na(pm25_concentration), pm25_mean, pm25_concentration),
    pm10_concentration = ifelse(is.na(pm10_concentration), pm10_mean, pm10_concentration)
  )
```

```{r}
sum(is.na(clean_data$pm25_concentration))
sum(is.na(clean_data$pm10_concentration))
```
```{r}
correlation <- cor(clean_data$pm25_concentration, clean_data$pm10_concentration)
round(correlation, 3)
```
```{r}
cor_test <- cor.test(clean_data$pm25_concentration, clean_data$pm10_concentration)
cor_test
```

```{r}
model <- lm(pm25_concentration ~ pm10_concentration, data = clean_data)
model
```

```{r}
r_squared <- summary(model)$r.squared
slope <- coef(model)[2]
intercept <- coef(model)[1]

round(r_squared, 3)

```
```{r}
print(paste("Regression equation: PM2.5 =", round(intercept, 3), "+", round(slope, 3), "* PM10"))

```

```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(clean_data, aes(x = pm10_concentration, y = pm25_concentration)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, color = "blue", size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", se = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Relationship between PM2.5 and PM10 Concentrations",
    subtitle = paste("Correlation:", round(correlation, 3), "| R-squared:", round(r_squared, 3)),
    x = "PM10 Concentration (μg/m³)",
    y = "PM2.5 Concentration (μg/m³)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(p1)
```
```{r}
p2 <- ggplot(clean_data) +
  geom_density(aes(x = pm25_concentration), fill = "blue", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_density(aes(x = pm10_concentration), fill = "red", alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of PM2.5 and PM10 Concentrations",
    x = "Concentration (μg/m³)",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(p2)
```

```{r}

new_pm10 <- data.frame(pm10_concentration = c(20, 50, 100, 150, 200))
predictions <- predict(model, newdata = new_pm10)

prediction_df <- data.frame(
  PM10_Input = new_pm10$pm10_concentration,
  Predicted_PM25 = round(predictions, 2)
)

print("Prediction examples:")
prediction_df

```

```{r}
print(" CONCLUSIONS ")

strength <- ifelse(correlation > 0.7, "strong positive",
  ifelse(correlation > 0.4, "moderate positive",
    ifelse(correlation > 0.2, "weak positive", "very weak or no")
  )
)

print(paste("CONCLUSION: There is a", strength, "relationship between PM2.5 and PM10."))
print(paste("Correlation coefficient (r):", round(correlation, 3)))
print(paste("R-squared:", round(r_squared, 3), "meaning that", round(r_squared * 100, 1), "% of PM2.5 variation can be explained by PM10."))
print(paste("Statistical significance: p-value =", format.pval(cor_test$p.value, digits = 3)))
```
